notes.title: My Name is Mayo 3 is out!
notes.notes:
The third, the myth, the legend... the end of an era. Mayo will meet the ultimate destiny in this last journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38966152/15021fbbeef119bff8a241ab25e58966b49196c5.png[/img]


It’s time to get down and groovy with Mayo once again, as we release a nifty end to the trilogy nobody asked for! 

My Name is Mayo 3 is out and about! So uncover the weird stories, click the jar, and (literally) walk along Mayo’s toughest journey. Maybe you’ll learn from it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1779460/My_Name_is_Mayo_3/

Once again, we’re very thankful for your love of Mayonnaise!

Cheers,
Sean Callaghan
Community Manager Sage
